blocks.text: At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we’re dedicated to offering top-notch Air Quality in Castle Hills, TX. Poor indoor air quality can lead to an array of health issues, including sneezing, coughing, and itchy eyes. It can make asthma and allergy symptoms worse. In addition, long-term exposure to certain types of pollutants has been linked to heart and lung disease.

If you’re noticing unusual odors in your home, it could be because of an air quality issue. Having our technicians test the air in your home can help you understand the specifics of your situation. They’ll be able to answer any of your questions about your options for getting the air in your space clean.
Castle Hills Best Air Quality Team

There are several options for cleaning indoor air. You can upgrade the air filters in both your heater and air conditioners so that they’re more effective at removing pollutants from the air. Purifiers and air scrubbers are also highly efficient at getting rid of certain types of pollutants. Dehumidifiers make you more comfortable living indoors during the hot, humid, Texas summer months.

If you’re concerned about the spread of disease in your home, you can consider getting a UV light installed. These units are installed in the ductwork of a home and can expose bacteria, viruses, and mold to their light. This will deactivate the DNA of these disease-causing agents so that they can’t make you sick.
